profiles.interpretation: Infeasibility rules out simultaneous strict target attainment by any whole-meal combination. Fractional feasibility does not prove existence of an admissible integer menu.
profiles.scope: One fractional convex combination of observed meals per position; all energy and nutrient inequalities. Binary selection is relaxed.
